NAME:
   rancher create - Create resources

USAGE:
   rancher create [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   cluster:                  Create a provisioning cluster (--import, --custom, or --machine-config for a node-driver cluster)
   kubeconfig:               Create a kubeconfig with an embedded token
   machine-config:           Create a machine config for the machine pool of a node-driver cluster
   namespace:                Create a namespace, optionally inside a project
   oidc-client:              [Prime] Create an OIDC client for Rancher's embedded OIDC provider
   password-change-request:  Change a local user's password
   project:                  Create a project in a cluster
   resource:                 Create a resource from a manifest file
   secret:                   Create a secret, optionally project-scoped
   token:                    Create a token on the server
   user:                     Create a local user and bind its global roles

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --project string            the project, by id or display name, on the cluster given by --cluster (only commands that take --project accept it)
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
